title: Perfect projection for one constant quotient
statement: With d, f:U→V, n and the fixed finite mate π_n of [def-sp-constant-quotient-projection], assume that each positive quotient A/I^m is perfect over A [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], as recorded in d. For every unbounded K in D(U,A), π_n(K) is an isomorphism in D(V,A). The morphism is the specified counit mate, with no new choice of source or target isomorphisms. There is no completeness, properness, smoothness, etale-origin or boundedness hypothesis on K or f.

proof.text: Choose a bounded finite-projective scalar resolution using d.quotientPerfect, realize its derived isomorphism by an actual augmentation using K-projective lifting, and apply the exact constant-module functor. Finite projective modules are retracts of finite free modules, and constant realization preserves the splittings and finite support. proEtaleStrictPerfect_flat gives a flat K-flat representative F of the constant quotient. These are the existing scalarResolution, constantFiniteRetract and constantResolution helpers.
